language.title: Language of the app
language.autoHint: Each browser uses its own language when the app has it, English otherwise. This browser: {language}.
language.hint: Applies to every browser that opens the app, after saving. E-mail and push notifications stay in English.

folders.sourcesHint: Where the videos to convert are, as paths on the server. A name is shown instead of the path in the app (e.g. “Downloads”). Protect a folder to stop its files being deleted from the app (e.g. while a download client is seeding them).
folders.nameTitle: Friendly name shown instead of the path
folders.protectTitle: Protect: files and folders in here can't be deleted from the app
folders.removeLast: At least one sources folder is needed
folders.remove: Remove this folder from the list (nothing is deleted)
folders.targetHint: All folders must already exist on the server. The target cannot be inside a sources folder, and a sources folder cannot be inside another one.

adding.title: When you add a folder
adding.skipConverted: Skip files that were already converted
adding.skipConvertedHint: Use “Convert again” in the job details to redo one.
adding.exclude: Skip files and folders containing these words

output.title: Output folder layout
output.suffixHint: If a file with the same name exists, the new one gets a suffix: “episode (1).mkv”.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.niceHint: 0–19. Higher is gentler on other services on the server (media server, downloads); encodes take a little longer.

verify.fullHint: Lengths, tracks and a complete decode of every frame (about 1–2 min per episode).
verify.offHint: Files count as converted as soon as HandBrake finishes.

quality.title: Resolution and bitrate
quality.minKbps: Lowest acceptable video bitrate (kbps) for H.264-class video; 0 = no check
quality.applyHint: Changes apply to existing results straight away; no new check is needed.

renaming.title: Renaming
renaming.autoHint: Only files the rules recognise without warnings are renamed; the rest are marked “Needs rename” for the Rename view.
renaming.separator: Separator before the number when a name is taken

schedule.title: Conversion window
schedule.intro: Convert only at certain times, e.g. at night, so encoding doesn’t compete with a media server or other services. Outside the window the queue holds the next job; a job that is converting when the window closes is finished first.
schedule.days: On these days (the day the window opens)
schedule.autoStart: Start the queue by itself when the window opens and jobs are waiting
schedule.autoStartHint: Otherwise press Start as usual; outside the window the queue then waits for it to open.
schedule.zoneWarning: The server’s clock is on {zone} (UTC{offset}), not this computer’s time zone. The window follows the server: set TZ in the server’s .env (e.g. TZ=Europe/London) and restart the container.

watch.title: Watch folders
watch.intro: New videos that appear in these folders are added to the queue by themselves. Files that are already there when you add a folder are left alone (drag them into the queue if you want them). Each file is added once.
watch.browseTitle: Pick the folder by browsing the server
watch.outside: Must be inside one of the sources folders.
watch.remove: Stop watching this folder (nothing is deleted)
watch.settle: Wait until a file has not changed for (minutes)
watch.settleHint: So files still downloading or copying are not picked up.
watch.autoStart: Start the queue after adding files
watch.autoStartHint: With the conversion window on, the queue then waits for the window to open.
watch.offSave: Watching is off (save to turn it on).

notifications.eventsHint: E-mail and webhooks follow this list, unless a webhook has its own choice below.

events.queueFinishedHint: One message per run, listing every file.
events.jobDoneHint: Can be a lot of messages for a long queue.

notifications.noChannel: Turn on a webhook or e-mail below for these to go anywhere.
notifications.appUrl: Address of this app, for links in messages (optional)
notifications.webhooksHint: A JSON POST for each message: an n8n Webhook node, a Home Assistant webhook trigger, ntfy, Gotify… Add as many as you need (up to 10), each with the events it should get.
notifications.passwordSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it, or {remove}.
notifications.passwordHint: For Gmail and Outlook use an app password.
notifications.passwordStored: The password is stored on the server and included in backups; it is never sent back to the browser.
notifications.browserHint: The tab title always shows the progress (“42% · Show S01e02.mkv”). Desktop notifications appear when this tab is in the background. These choices are kept in this browser only.
notifications.browserUnsupported: Browsers allow desktop notifications only on https:// pages or localhost. Open the app through an https reverse proxy to use them, or use e-mail or a webhook.
notifications.browserBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser’s settings.
notifications.nothingSent: Nothing sent since the server started.

backup.scheduleHint: Makes a backup by itself, e.g. every night into a folder on your NAS, and keeps the newest ones. If the server was off at that time, the backup is made as soon as it is back.
backup.folderHint: Empty = the app’s own data folder (data/backups). A network share works if it is mounted on the server and, with Docker, inside the mounted media folder (e.g. /mnt/media/backups/handbrake-ui).
backup.browseTitle: Pick a folder under the sources or target folders; any other path can be typed
backup.makeHint: Settings, presets, rename rules, the job list and history, merges and quality results. Video files are not included.
backup.orPick: or pick one of the backups on the server below.
backup.configOnlyHint: Settings, presets and rename rules. Jobs and history stay as they are.
backup.everythingHint: Also jobs, their logs, rename history, merges and quality results. The queue stays stopped.
backup.noneOnServer: None yet. “Save on the server” and every restore add one here.
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete the backup {name} from the server?
backup.restoreAllMessage: Everything will be replaced with the backup: settings, presets, rename rules, jobs and their logs, rename history, merges and quality results.
backup.restoreConfigMessage: Settings, presets and rename rules will be replaced with the backup. Jobs and history stay as they are.
backup.restoreSavedFirst: The current data is saved on the server first, so you can go back to it from Settings → Backup and restore.
backup.restoredSavedAs: The data from before is saved on the server as {name}. The page reloads now.

about.summary: Turns a headless Linux box into a HandBrake conversion server: pick videos on the server (or upload them), queue them with HandBrake presets (made in its preset editor or imported from the desktop app), and get checked, renamed results. It runs the official HandBrakeCLI and is not affiliated with the HandBrake project.
